question: Does label-free even-channel balancing rescue the weak small-SiLU channel under new dimension, distributions and target structure?
parity_balance: multiply centered even channels to match paired ReLU even/odd energy ratio on training inputs; never uses labels; preserve odd channel

predictions.claim: At scale0.03 plain SiLU interaction initial kernel energy remains less than0.1 ReLU while linear_sum energy remains greater than0.5 ReLU.
predictions.criterion: all paired seeds, both new distributions

predictions.claim: Label-free parity balance rescues SiLU interaction energy at scale0.03 by at least20fold and to at least0.5 ReLU; linear_sum energy changes only through the prescribed odd/total normalization.
Parity-balanced scale0.03 SiLU has lower2048-step interaction test MSE than plain SiLU, in at least3/4seeds in each distribution.
predictions.criterion: seed wins and dataset-level mean sign, no posthoc early stopping

predictions.claim: With matched even/odd ratio, SiLU scale0.03 and0.1 linear_sum kernel energies match within1e-8; interaction energies within10percent.
predictions.criterion: all paired seeds; exact odd part and near-quadratic even part

predictions.claim: Observed training curves remain predicted by their measured fixed-feature spectra to1e-8.

analysis.research_units: two input distributions × two target functions, seeds condition repeats
analysis.holdout_protocol: full specification and previous report bytes frozen before first OOD tensor generation; OOD seen after this phase becomes development for future iterations
